$comment_reactCompiler: Default-ON opt-out lever for Next 16's React Compiler (ADR-048). true (or absent) enables auto-memoization of client components via the Babel transform; the trade is ~35% added build time on every build. A fork that doesn't want that cost sets this to false — next.config.ts reads it and disables the compiler. Mirrors the config-driven locales/tier levers and the dockerAck/complexityAck opt-out precedent for fleet-wide costs.
$comment_pristine: TEMPLATE-ONLY marker. `true` exempts the repo from the ADR-031 db-structure domain-model check (the pristine template deliberately ships baseline-only; a fork's first /quickstart scaffolds the first model). Every fork-creation path clears it (scripts/rebrand.mjs, scripts/deploy.mjs, scripts/new-project.mjs set it to false), so every fork is gated. Do NOT set it back to true in a fork — use `dbAck` for a genuinely stateless fork. See scripts/ship.mjs scanDbStructure + ADR-031.
$comment: tier governs project ceremony, NOT the security floor (which is identical for both). 'personal' = never shared with the company: no /handoff, no compliance section, no CI ceremony. 'shared' = company project that flows to an IT handoff and may carry PDPL/compliance obligations: adds /handoff, the compliance section in SECURITY.md, CI activation at handoff, formal findings register. Set during /first-fork. See CLAUDE.md 'Project tiers' for the full contract.
$comment_locales: locales is the single source of truth for which next-intl locales this fork ships (i18n/config.ts derives the routing, the URL prefix regex, and the <html dir> direction from it). Default is English-only ['en']; a fork that needs Arabic/RTL flips it to ['en','ar'] (or any subset) — messages/ar.json + all RTL code stay in the repo, inert until re-enabled. RTL direction is automatic for ar/he/fa/ur (see RTL_LOCALES in i18n/config.ts). The locale switcher hides when only one locale is configured. ADR-001 / blueprint enterprise-design-system-and-i18n.
$comment_velocityBaselines: Velocity-pillar warm baselines (V2-103). shipWarmSeconds: /ship warns when total > 125% (a warm cached build; cold/--full builds legitimately exceed). hookChainMs: UserPromptSubmit+PreToolUse chain, warns > 150% (npm run hook-latency --record to refresh on a representative machine). All three velocity checks are advisory/fail-open.
